description: This file defines the CKEDITOR.xml class, which represents and manipulates loaded XML documents, including parsing XML strings, selecting nodes via XPath, and serializing inner XML.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.xml
classes.description: Class representing a loaded XML document with methods for XPath queries and serialization.

methods.name: selectSingleNode
methods.description: Executes an XPath query to select a single node from the XML document.

methods.name: selectNodes
methods.description: Executes an XPath query to select multiple nodes from the XML document.

methods.name: getInnerXml
methods.description: Retrieves the inner XML of a node specified by an XPath query.
